items.title: Lemmer named John O. Hallquist Endowed Professor in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
items.summary: KALAMAZOO, Mich.— Dr. Kristina M. Lemmer , a leading researcher in plasma and electric propulsion for spacecraft, has been named a John O. Hallquist Endowed Professor in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at Western Michigan University. The award recognizes her exceptional professional…
